notes: Neutral herald angel (planned AP-012, a series with no gameplay card yet, so testBed only means 'no card'). The first male hero in the art pipeline: he introduced pose-male-human.txt and the male physique (build/chest/arms/waist/legs) branch in gen_prompt.py's tokens_for(). His Prime wears pearlescent pastel trunks, a lighter sheen than Angelica's iridescent bikini. Hair, eyes and skin are fixed like every other angel (light ash-brown, steel grey, fair warm-neutral) and forced at 1_Prime, with the build applied at 2_Bare. Palette (Soft Pearl White / Warm Champagne Gold / Dove Grey) is his wardrobe scheme. The free test-bed for any photo is alpha/male.
